2609.07107.title: Beyond Sparse Rewards: A New Benchmark and Structure-Aware Graph Alignment for Micro-Drama Understanding
2609.07107.paper_summary: Micro-dramas, characterized by ultra-short durations and hyper-dense storylines, pose unique challenges for video understanding that conventional benchmarks fail to address. To bridge this gap, we introduce M-Drama, the first large-scale bilingual benchmark for micro-drama comprehension, featuring over 35K instances across 9,138 clips. Furthermore, while reinforcement learning can enhance VLMs on complex narratives, existing reward metrics often suffer from sparse and superficial signals, failing to capture intricate character identities and temporal structures. We propose SAGA (Structure-Aware Graph Alignment), a novel graph-matching reward function that models narratives as heterogeneous graphs. SAGA computes dense, rigorous rewards via decoupled semantic triplet and structural temporal matching. Extensive experiments on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct demonstrate that SAGA outperforms existing baselines, delivering substantial improvements in open-ended accuracy and summary quality, while maintaining competitive out-of-domain generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/qyx1121/MDrama_SAGA.
2609.07107.paper_summary_zh: 微型劇以超短的時長和超密集的故事情節為特徵，對於視頻理解提出了獨特的挑戰，而傳統基準無法解決這些問題。為了填補這一空白，我們推出了M-Drama，這是首個大型雙語微型劇理解基準，包含超過35K的實例，涵蓋9,138個片段。此外，雖然強化學習可以提升VLM在複雜敘事上的表現，但現有的獎勵指標通常受到稀疏和表面信號的影響，無法捕捉複雜的人物身份和時間結構。我們提出了SAGA（結構感知圖對齊），這是一種新穎的圖匹配獎勵函數，將敘事建模為異質圖。SAGA通過解耦的語義三元組和結構時間匹配計算密集且嚴謹的獎勵。在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上的大量實驗表明，SAGA超越了現有基準，在開放式準確性和摘要質量上實現了顯著改進，同時保持了競爭力的域外泛化。代碼可在https://github.com/qyx1121/MDrama_SAGA獲得。
